## 🔐 Why This Is Dangerous

| Component | Risk |
|---|---|
| `'; ` | Terminates the legitimate query early |
| `CREATE FUNCTION evil()` | Injects a persistent malicious function into the DB |
| `DROP TABLE users CASCADE` | **Permanently destroys** the users table and all dependent objects |
| `SELECT evil()` | Executes the attack immediately |
| `--` | Hides/neutralizes any trailing safe SQL |

## ✅ The Correct & Safe Approach

Always use **parameterized queries / prepared statements**:

    "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = %s",
    (username_input,)   # ← value passed separately, never interpolated
)
